- llama: honor PARTIAL_ONLY in the plain KV cache

A non-SWA llama_kv_cache rolls back with seq_rm, so it holds no

partial state, yet state_write ignored the flag and serialized every

cell. A draft context made of a plain KV cache (MTP head, dense -md

draft) therefore copied its whole KV into each server checkpoint,

growing it by the draft KV size per token.

The cache now writes and reads nothing for PARTIAL_ONLY unless it is

- Update src/llama-kv-cache.cpp

Co-authored-by: Georgi Gerganov ggerganov@gmail.com

- llama: delegate PARTIAL_ONLY to the caches of every memory wrapper

The hybrid, hybrid-idx and dsa-iswa wrappers skipped their attention

caches on PARTIAL_ONLY, which also dropped an SWA window that is

partial state. Each cache now applies the flag itself, so the

wrappers only delegate. The indexer is marked stale only when a

test-llama-context gains a case checking that the partial state is
